test_multiple_inheritance_cpp: test the pybind11 MIType class that inherits from Base1 and Base2 C++ bases
test_multiple_inheritance_mix1: test a Python class that inherits from a pure Python base and a pybind11 C++ base
test_multiple_inheritance_mix2: test a Python class that inherits from a pybind11 C++ base and a pure Python base
test_multiple_inheritance_python: test complex Python multiple inheritance hierarchies mixing pybind11 C++ bases with pure Python bases
test_diamond_inheritance: test the pybind11 diamond inheritance pattern where D inherits from C0 and C1 which both inherit from B
